also_verified_on: 1.0.1-R2006.1, 1.1.0-R2009.1, 1.1.0-R2074.1 (wrong-type oracle identical on all 29 keys, 2026-09-05; only the reasoning_effort enum differs — its row)
count_reconciliation: DISCREPANCY (resolved): settings-plugins.md §8 tabulates 30 rows (29 + `mcp_servers` as 'alias, also a real FIELDS entry'). Its own verification C4 shows `mcpServers` and `mcp_servers` are NOT serde members (a duplicate-key probe is silent for both, like an unknown key) — they are read by a separate pass with its own error channel — and counts 28 SettingsFile-proper members. config-paths.md verification C2 measured the same 28 by the duplicate-field oracle against a struct arity of 29. The 29 here = the 28 derived members + `mcpServers`; `mcp_servers` is recorded under `legacy_spellings`, not as a 30th key.
rewrite_behaviour: Muse rewrites settings.json from the typed struct: unknown top-level keys are silently ignored on load and destroyed on the next rewrite; unknown `tui` sub-keys are dropped; `plugins` and `permissions` are RawValue members that survive byte-for-byte. Never store framework state here.
schema_version_rule: u32, hard-required (missing field / null / string all fail), must be exactly 1 (0 and 2 → `unsupported settings schema version N`).
load_failure_rule: A wrong TYPE on any typed key makes the whole file malformed and every settings-consuming command exits 1 (`--version --help export init workflows list` still succeed — probe with `muse skills list`). A wrong type on a lazy key loads fine and degrades only that subsystem (often TUI-only messages).
mcp_collision_rule: `mcpServers` and `mcp_servers` both present — even both `{}` — makes every settings-MUTATING command exit 1 with `MCP configuration error in "<CFG>/settings.json"; MCP is disabled for this runtime`; read-only lanes stay silent. The offline validator `muse config validate --plane defaults` accepts the snake_case `settings.mcp_servers` spelling (camelCase `mcpServers` on the validator was not tested).

items.notes: See schema_version_rule.

Written by `muse plugins approve|reject`; `plugins disable` DELETES the line; any package byte change flips native capabilities to modified. Spawn gate is literally `enabled:true` + matching hash = trusted_enabled. One malformed entry takes both wired reminders down.

structural.notes: A required member of the object, not a value omm owns: restoring a leaf under `permissions` to absent never removes `schema_version` while other members remain (the host refuses the whole object without it: `Named permission profiles are unavailable: missing field schema_version`, measured 2026-09-02); it goes only with the last other member.

fields.profiles: map <id> → PermissionProfileDefinitionInputV1 {approval, reviewer, filesystem, network, extends}. reviewer is a string enum on 1.3.0-R3057.1: "none" pairs only with non-prompting approval (else `contradictory authority: prompting approval requires a reviewer`); any other value names the profile (`invalid reviewer value `v` for permission profile `id``); "human" in a non-default profile fails the whole object closed (`missing field schema_version`, exit 1) while the default profile tolerates it — omit reviewer and inherit it from the extends base (measured: s19 reviewer sweep, 2026-09-16).

items.notes: On 1.0.x failure is non-fatal: `muse: Named permission profiles are unavailable: …`. On 1.3.0-R3057.1 a profile-shaped failure is fatal (exec exits 1 with the same prefix). Built-in profiles :read-only, :ask-me (default), :auto-review, :unrestricted. RawValue — survives rewrite verbatim.

mcp_server_fields.type_note: Only the three enums (mode, transport, framing) are proven by validator/serde messages; the other types are inferred from the field names and the transport rules below.
validation_literals: transport is ambiguous with both command and url
stdio transport must not set url
streamable_http transport must not set command
streamable_http transport must not set args or env
streamable_http transport must not set stdio framing
server name must not be blank
server name must not contain surrounding whitespace
mcp_server_fields.validation_note: These literals exist but are NOT reachable from a user settings.json load — a bad entry is silent (config-paths verification C1). Plugin-manifest mcpServers differ: transports stdio|http only, and env/cwd/headers validate then are dropped at launch.

enterprise_defaults_plane.note: Offline oracle: `muse config validate --plane defaults --file <tmp>` (no gate). Accepted settings.* members probed live: tools, skills, mcp_servers, endpoint_transport, telemetry, notifications, model, provider, run, tui (11 of 14 fields), presets, max_consecutive_stop_hook_continuations. Rejected as unknown_member: hooks, managed_hooks_path, managed_hooks_env_vars, plugins. The validator takes the snake_case `mcp_servers` spelling; camelCase `mcpServers` was not tested against it.

notes: Writers that touch this file: muse skills enable|disable|user-only (skills.activation), muse plugins approve|reject|disable (runtime_capabilities), the TUI /settings, /theme, /keymap, /plugins panels. Nothing writes `plugins`.

R9 contract: only these 29 keys may be patched by omm, each recorded with its prior value; validate the candidate with `muse config validate --plane defaults --file <tmp>` first (note the validator was only exercised with `mcp_servers`; the runtime reads both spellings and refuses when both are present).
Under `agent_definitions.safe_mode: true` user/project/plugin agent packs never load.
